title: incident-bot: runbook quicklinks and SLO auto-diagnostics priority hints
author: Samir Patel
description: Context: On-call responders and SREs need faster access to runbooks when incidents are surfaced by the SLO toolkit. This PR adds runbook quicklink suggestions directly to incident-bot diagnostics cards and surfaces SLO auto-diagnostics priority hints to help responders triage high-impact alerts first. Motivation: Reduce time-to-mitigation by surfacing likely-relevant runbooks and giving explicit priority hints derived from SLO breach characteristics and historical incident impact. Changes: 1) Add a runbook quicklinks widget to the incident summary card that queries runbook metadata service with fuzzy matching on service/component and SLO tags. 2) Integrate a priority hint generator in the SLO auto-diagnostics pipeline that scores diagnostics by expected customer impact and recovery complexity. 3) Provide a fallback ranking that prefers canonical runbooks tagged "oncall-primary" and experimental heuristics scoped behind a feature flag. 4) Add end-to-end tests and update incident-bot UI docs and runbook metadata docs. Implementation notes: Runbook query uses the existing runbook-index HTTP endpoint, with caching at the incident-bot layer to avoid extra RPC on hot alerts. Priority hints are computed from a lightweight rule-set plus a decay-weighted incident-frequency signal stored in SLO toolkit metrics. Feature flag: incidentbot.runbook_quicklinks=true; default off for on-prem/private installs. Testing: Unit tests for matching logic and priority scoring included. Integration test added that runs a synthetic SLO breach and asserts quicklinks and priority hint appear in the diagnostic payload. Rollout plan: Feature flagged rollout starting with internal and SRE teams, gradual enable using Canary group in 2 stages, monitor alert-response latency and runbook click-through. Related: ENG-1294, ENG-1302, SUP-4421. This description is continuous without section breaks per repo guidelines.

review_comments: Elena Garcia: Can we ensure the cache TTL is configurable per-deployment? Suggest exposing via config with conservative default.
Samir Patel (author): Added cache_ttl to incident-bot config and documented in deploy notes. Default 30s internally to avoid stale suggestions.
Noah Lee: Priority hints look useful. What safeguards do we have to avoid misleading low-confidence hints?
Samir Patel (author): Hints include a confidence score field; UI shows hint only when confidence >= 0.6. Also added telemetry to track false-positive feedback.
Priya Raman: Minor nits in docs and one test race condition found in integration run. Please address before merge.
Samir Patel (author): Fixed doc nits and added retry/backoff in integration test to stabilize.
release_notes: Add runbook quicklinks to incident diagnostics and SLO auto-diagnostics priority hints. Feature-flagged rollout. Improves on-call triage and runbook discoverability.
